Emerald's overlay of 21.json (positions in the tiles of BattleTower_Lobby's Emerald variant): the exits (12,9) (13,9); MAN_5 (12,3: a counter in Emerald) at Emerald's MAN_4 (23,5), the woman, the boy and the reporter at Emerald's places (17,8) (15,9) (11,9); the records terminal's sign on the singles counter (5,5) (Sapphire's (3,5) is floor in Emerald). The doubles / multis / link multis receptionists (10,5) (14,5) (18,5) are not placed. BattleTower_Lobby (zone 21), built by the specials agent (recipe data/interior_layouts/BattleTower_Lobby.json): Nimbasa Battle Test look, Black 2 interior area 306. A plain Sapphire room for now: the PWT link waits for the island and the story (notes/DECISIONS.md). Warps in Sapphire's order (warps 0/1 lead to BattleTower_Outside, not built yet: they point at this room's own warp 0 until the island exists). People (battle_tower agent, 2026-10-08): Sapphire's six objects by their local ids as uids, in uid order (index = uid - 1): the receptionist (TEALA = Teala, code 79 (data/sprite_map.json OBJ_EVENT_GFX_TEALA: Sapphire's own Teala redrawn, as in the Pokémon Centers)), MAN_5, WOMAN_7 and BOY_1 (uids 3/4, the specials agent's), the reporter and the award man (hidden by their flags); the records sign (3,5), read facing north. Scripts 3-7 are the battle_tower agent's.
